how: We read the website of every Charleston wedding videographer listed on Lazo (98 listings, 74 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: photographers who do not film, an Atlanta studio, a multi-state team with a Charleston landing page, a multi-service chain, and beach-ceremony package sellers. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you record vows and toasts outdoors with wind off the harbor: lapel mics, a recorder on the officiant, or a board feed?
When do the highlight film and the full ceremony edit arrive, and are raw files or next-day clips part of the package?
Is there an hourly cap, and what does it cost if the reception runs past it?

picks.name: Charleston Photo Art
picks.blurb: Charleston Photo Art bundles cinematic video with photography in every collection, so one Mt Pleasant team covers both. Founded by Dennis Aliaksandrou in 2016, with a page that walks through what photography and videography cost in Charleston.

picks.name: Surrender Films
picks.blurb: Rob of Surrender Films delivers next-day clips so you can relive and share the day right away, alongside the cinematic film. After filming more than 500 couples over eight years, he says his favorite part is hearing about couples' future children watching the film. Wedding and elopement coverage from Charleston.

picks.name: Lowcountry Wedding Films
picks.blurb: Lowcountry Wedding Films calls Charleston home and works across the Lowcountry, including Savannah and Beaufort. Its pitch is experiences over expectations, and the site leads with couples describing their own films, which it frames as family heirlooms.

picks.name: Francis West Studios
picks.blurb: Francis West Studios is a Charleston videography team using seasoned local cinematographers for weddings in Charleston, Hilton Head and Savannah. The founder traces the work to a childhood pull toward music and visual storytelling, and promises films that are not rushed, overproduced or reduced to a checklist.

picks.name: Charleston Wedding Videographers-SBM
picks.blurb: Sweet Bliss Media is a Charleston studio doing wedding photography and videography together, with wedding planning and bridal and family sessions on the services list. Candid, natural, timeless coverage of every meaningful moment, in the studio's words.

picks.name: Four Pedal Films
picks.blurb: Four Pedal Films is boutique wedding videography from Myrtle Beach, run by Kip, Chris and Amanda. Kip has been a full-time Grand Strand photographer since 2007 and recently filmed his 300th wedding; every collection includes a handcrafted cinematic feature film customized to the day.

picks.name: Hart to Heart Media
picks.blurb: Hart to Heart Media has grown from one filmmaker into a collaboration of several, filming Charleston and Hilton Head weddings from Surfside Beach. The team has filmed NBA owners and music entertainers, but says couples' days are the most special ones.

picks.name: StanWeddings.com
picks.blurb: Stan learned to catch the moment in any environment as a paparazzi photographer for a magazine before his family moved from New Jersey to South Carolina in 2012 and opened a Myrtle Beach studio. StanWeddings does photography and creative wedding films, available worldwide.
